evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct outperforms the larger Qwen2-Math-Instruct 72B model. With the help of a reward model, the 7B instruct model can solve up to 21 problems, demonstrating strong mathematical problem-solving ability.

identity.name: Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct
identity.summary: Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct is an instruction-tuned model for chat, part of a math-specialized series supporting Chinese and English with advanced mathematical reasoning.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports only benchmark-style math problem-solving results and gives no documentation of design, training data, or evaluation process for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card summary does not describe the training or fine-tuning datasets used for Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: The card describes a general math chat/instruct model but does not define intended use cases or limitations, leaving downstream risk assessment underspecified.
